beats.headline: Broadcom gains 6.2% following Form 8-K filing
beats.explanation: Broadcom shares climbed 6.21% to close at $333.97 on 1.3 times average volume following an 8-K filing on April 6. The advance was company-specific, significantly outpacing peers such as competitor AMD (+0.61%) and supplier TSM (+1.04%), though competitor INTC also rose 4.20%.

beats.headline: Broadcom rises 4.2% outpacing semiconductor peers
beats.explanation: Broadcom gained 4.19% to finish at $396.72 without company-specific news. The advance outpaced competitors AMD (+1.20%), NVDA (+1.20%), and INTC (+1.77%), while supplier TSM declined 1.26%.

beats.headline: Broadcom climbs 5.5% alongside NVDA and TSM
beats.explanation: Broadcom moved up 5.52% to $439.79 despite light trading volume at 0.8 times its 30-day average. The gain was shared with supplier TSM (+4.48%) and competitor NVDA (+4.39%), while competitors QCOM and INTC fell 6.14% and 3.62%, respectively.

beats.headline: Broadcom advances 4.7% as broader peers weaken
beats.explanation: Broadcom rose 4.73% to $446.77 on 1.6 times average volume without any company filings. The move was largely company-specific, as competitor AMD dropped 0.38%, competitor NVDA fell 1.45%, and supplier TSM fell 1.51%.

beats.headline: Broadcom adds 4.7% reaching fresh peak near $482
beats.explanation: Broadcom climbed 4.70% to close at $481.57 with 1.5 times typical volume in the absence of specific corporate disclosures. Peer performance was mixed, with competitor QCOM up 5.17% and supplier TSM up 2.54%, while competitor NVDA slipped 0.69%.

beats.headline: Broadcom plunges 12.6% on 8-K and heavy volume
beats.explanation: Broadcom tumbled 12.59% to $418.91 on heavy volume reaching 3.1 times its 30-day average following an 8-K filing on June 3. The sharp decline was company-specific, diverging from supplier TSM (+1.89%) and competitor NVDA (+1.82%), while competitor AMD dropped 3.56%.

beats.headline: Broadcom rebounds 4.3% with mixed peer action
beats.explanation: Broadcom shares gained 4.30% to $392.90 on 1.6 times typical volume without company-specific news. Strength was shared with competitor INTC (+3.46%) and supplier TSM (+1.48%), though competitors NVDA (-1.33%) and QCOM (-0.51%) traded lower.

beats.headline: Broadcom drops 4.7% diverging from gaining peers
beats.explanation: Broadcom shed 4.67% to $392.13 on average trading volume without corporate announcements. The retreat was company-specific, occurring even as competitor INTC rose 5.19%, competitor AMD jumped 2.65%, and supplier TSM gained 1.20%.

beats.headline: Broadcom slips 3.1% amid broad peer selloff
beats.explanation: Broadcom declined 3.06% to $380.15 on 1.3 times normal volume. The drop was shared broadly across the industry, as supplier TSM fell 6.69% and competitors QCOM, INTC, and AMD declined 8.01%, 6.14%, and 5.76%, respectively.

beats.headline: Broadcom climbs 4.8% following Form 8-K filing
beats.explanation: Broadcom rose 4.83% to $388.69 on 1.2 times average volume after an 8-K filing dated July 6. The upward move was accompanied by competitor NVDA rising 3.65% and competitor QCOM advancing 1.96%.

beats.headline: Broadcom retreats 5.9% as AMD surges
beats.explanation: Broadcom shares fell 5.94% to $392.99 on slightly elevated volume without company-specific disclosures. The decline was idiosyncratic, as competitor AMD rallied 6.50% and competitor QCOM edged up 0.61%.

beats.headline: Broadcom falls 4.6% amid peer weakness
beats.explanation: Broadcom dropped 4.61% to finish at $362.48 on 1.4 times normal volume. The downward pressure was shared with competitors INTC (-4.02%) and AMD (-3.71%), while supplier TSM also dipped 0.32%.

arc: Broadcom experienced an aggressive spring expansion followed by elevated volatility and consolidation over the spring and summer of 2026. After surging from $314.43 in early April to a high of $481.57 by early June, the stock suffered a sharp 12.59% company-specific single-day drop on June 4 following an 8-K filing. Across the subsequent months, Broadcom's price swings oscillated between company-specific divergence—such as its steep retreats on June 22 and August 14 despite gains in peers like INTC and AMD—and shared industry-wide drawdowns on June 23 and August 19, leaving the stock consolidating in the mid-to-high $300s.
